scope: All functions in mlguess/keras and mlguess/keras/deprecated except data.py, which is audited separately.

runtime.execution_platform: Linux; native macOS and Windows execution not performed here

validation.test_command: KERAS_BACKEND=torch OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 python -m pytest -q mlguess/tests/test_audit_keras.py mlguess/tests/test_keras_lotv.py mlguess/tests/test_legacy_lotv.py mlguess/tests/test_layers.py mlguess/tests/test_models.py --cov=mlguess.keras

limitations: Function entry and statement coverage are not proof of scientific correctness or complete path coverage.
TensorFlow and JAX backend implementations were source-reviewed but not installed or executed.
GPU, multi-process execution, and native macOS/Windows execution were not performed.
Optional imbalanced-learn balanced_classes generator path was source-reviewed but not executed.
Legacy ensemble config/file-layout variants were not exhaustively executed.
Keras emits upstream NumPy 2 __array__(copy=...) deprecation warnings; tested results pass.
Experimental class weighting expressions are retained; tests establish operational support, not validation of their modeling assumptions.
